title: VR drug-cue craving meta-analysis: analysis code
description: Three-level random-effects meta-analysis (REML, metafor) of VR drug-cue vs neutral-cue craving (Hedges' g), 30 cohorts / 55 contrasts, with CR2 cluster-robust inference (clubSandwich). Includes input data, R models and scripts for Supplementary Figures S3/S6.
